title: Slovakian Rice Flour Pancakes
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring fluffy rice flour pancakes, perfect for a post-workout meal, these briny pancakes are cooked on a cedar plank and are free from onions and garlic.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the rice flour, sugar, yeast, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Slowly add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the water to the batter and mix until fully incorporated.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let the batter rest in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Preheat a cedar plank in a pressure cooker by heating it over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the preheated cedar plank.
Close the pressure cooker lid and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove the pancakes from the pressure cooker and serve hot.
